evals.name: mic-not-working-content-url
evals.prompt: Мікрофон не працює в моєму застосунку, адреса content://media/...
evals.expected_output: Claude explains secure-context requirement, directs to Netlify Drop, not Termux first
assertions: Explains mic needs HTTPS/secure-context
Identifies content:// as the blocker
Recommends Netlify Drop as simplest fix
Does NOT recommend Termux local server as the primary solution

evals.name: apk-on-phone-only
evals.prompt: Готовий ставити інструменти, але збираємо APK тільки на Android смартфоні без ПК
evals.expected_output: Claude explains Android Studio isn't on phone, recommends GitHub Actions cloud build
assertions: States Android Studio does not exist for Android
Recommends GitHub Actions cloud build as realistic phone-only path
Mentions Termux build as the harder all-local alternative
Does NOT promise Android Studio on the phone

evals.name: single-file-distribution
evals.prompt: Зроби щоб я міг роздавати застосунок одним файлом
evals.expected_output: Claude inlines manifest (data URI), SW (Blob), icons (base64) into one HTML
assertions: Inlines manifest as data URI
Inlines service worker as Blob
Inlines icons as base64
Result is a single self-contained HTML

evals.name: one-button-update
evals.prompt: Хочу авто-оновлення як у професійних застосунків, однією кнопкою
evals.expected_output: Claude implements version.json check + banner + one-button apply (clear cache + reload)
assertions: Checks a remote version.json on startup
Shows update banner when newer version exists
One button clears SW caches and hard-reloads
Explains update workflow: change file + bump version.json

evals.name: code-protection-honesty
evals.prompt: Як захистити мою ідею щоб ніхто не вкрав код застосунку?
evals.expected_output: Claude is honest that client JS is always visible; real protection is server-side + speed/legal
assertions: States browser JS is always viewable (View Source)
Recommends keeping secrets server-side, not in client
Notes minification obscures but does not hide
Does NOT promise full code protection via client-side means

version_note: evals authored at v1.0.0, revalidated against skill v1.3.2 on 2026-07-03
